My dear [Irene](/person/538)
I send back the translation with many thanks for the sight of it. I was very sorry to see by the paper that the sorrow you feared has come,[^1] and that the year is closing on you in sorrow and mourning, perhaps of a kind that one feels doubly, through one’s parents as well as oneself. I do not know whether you are feeling able to care for these Gosling matters now but I think I told [Pena](/person/973) all about them.
The [Firefly](/person/1168) and [Cobweb](/person/675) had each three votes so they will each have an equal prize. Many thanks to you and [Glow Worm](/person/534) for your photographs, hers is one of the best, and I am glad to have seen her brown eyes, and know the likeness
your affectionate
Mother Goose


[^1]: The death of her aunt [Grace (Fursdon) Rogers](/person/1255) on 24 December 1861.
